title: velero DR backup chart values schema
description: Plan 2026-05-20 T2.5 ext — fail-fast on unreplaced REPLACE-AT-INSTALL-TIME placeholders. Critical because per binding memory feedback_velero_must_be_in_drill ('Velero MUST BE IN THE DRILL TEST') — silent placeholder leak in drill would cause Journey 12 to SKIP (Velero not installed) and mask drill prod-parity gap.

velero.description: Upstream velero chart values pass-through. Helmfile env templates inject bucket/region/s3Url at install time.

existingSecret.description: Name of Secret holding S3-compatible credentials (key=cloud in AWS INI format). Created by generate-secrets.sh per env (T1.3).

backupStorageLocation.description: At least one BSL required (otherwise Velero has no backup target).

provider.description: S3-compatible (aws), GCS, or Azure Blob. DO Spaces + MinIO use 'aws'.

bucket.description: Bucket name — MUST be templated by helmfile env values. Literal 'REPLACE-AT-INSTALL-TIME' = unreplaced placeholder bug. Schema rejects to fail-fast at lint time.

s3Url.description: S3-compatible endpoint URL. Must be templated by helmfile env. DO Spaces: https://<region>.digitaloceanspaces.com. MinIO: http://minio.loop-runtime-system.svc.cluster.local:9000.

s3ForcePathStyle.description: MUST be 'true' for DO Spaces + MinIO (path-style addressing). AWS S3 ignores.

volumeSnapshotLocation.description: Empty array OK — V1 does not back up PV data (per velero-backup-dr-plan ADR D4).

initContainers.description: At least one plugin init container required — velero-plugin-for-aws is canonical for S3-compatible targets.
